title_fa: خزندهٔ 21st.dev با مرورگرِ بی‌سر (Playwright + Edge) برای سایت‌ساز
note: Playwright 1.49.1 (Apache-2.0) in its own environment venvs/crawl21 - nothing of the owner's Python is touched. The browser is the Microsoft Edge that Windows 11 already has (channel msedge), then Chrome; if neither starts, `crawl21_jobs.py --check` runs `playwright install chromium` (the default CDN first, then the npmmirror mirrors). The job `crawl21.run` opens only PUBLIC 21st.dev pages, obeys robots.txt (every request the page makes is checked too), waits 1.5 s between pages and sends back the .md text and the usage demo code; the site parses and stores it (apps/projects/builder/c21_node.py). `kinds` makes the site keep the job in its durable queue until this is installed.

items.title: a headless browser starts (Edge, Chrome or Playwright's Chromium)
